problem: A high-priority radar signal can be correctly detected but still create no customer-facing or acquisition action.
root_cause: Signal detection and routing existed, but execution had to be owned through the actual content/provider path instead of terminating in a chat summary.
prevention: For external-only signals, choose a real governed action: contextual portal projection when tenant relevance exists, otherwise content/opportunity execution.
Never route company content to personal LinkedIn when organization capability is unproven.
Persist source evidence, canonical PH-P mapping, chosen action and blocker state in one lineage.

invariants: external evidence remains context until tenant relevance
accepted signal owns a real execution route
